name: Goo Goo Clusters chocolate
where: Goo Goo Chocolate Co., 3rd Avenue South
about: A peanut and caramel chocolate bar that started in Nashville. It is one of the city's best-known classic sweets.
tip: Buy a small box first, since the candy is sold in many sizes and boxes.

name: Nashville hot chicken dry rub
where: Hattie B's official stores and merchandise sellers
about: A spice blend that captures the fiery flavor of Nashville hot chicken. It comes sealed so you can season your own meat at home.
tip: Check that the package is sealed and buy from an official shop for the real blend.
